scenes.heading: QuickStart Jar Naming Convention (Part 2 of 2)
scenes.narration: Env Setup. QuickStart Jar Naming Convention (Part 2 of 2). In this video we review 5 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: Which part of the QuickStart Jar filename controls the listening port?
scenes.heading: The number after -p in the filename
scenes.body: The port is specified by the `-p<port>` segment in the filename. For example, `-p4502` means AEM will listen on port 4502. The port can be customized by changing this number in the filename.

scenes.question: What is the purpose of the environment segment (e.g., _prod, _stage) in the QuickStart Jar filename?
scenes.heading: It sets the environment run mode, activating environment-specific OSGi configurations
scenes.body: The environment segment (e.g., `_prod`, `_stage`, `_dev`) sets the AEM run mode for that environment. This allows environment-specific OSGi configurations to be loaded — for example, production configs that use different endpoints than dev configs.

scenes.question: What happens to the tier when the QuickStart Jar is started for the first time?
scenes.heading: The tier is locked and cannot be changed without deleting crx-quickstart
scenes.body: The tier (author or publish) is locked on first startup and stored in the `crx-quickstart` folder. If you rename the JAR file to change the tier and restart, AEM will use the stored tier — not the new filename. You must delete `crx-quickstart` to reset it.

scenes.question: What are the two valid values for the tier segment of the QuickStart Jar filename?
scenes.heading: author and publish
scenes.body: The tier segment in the QuickStart Jar filename accepts exactly two values: `author` (for the Author service on port 4502) and `publish` (for the Publish service on port 4503).

scenes.question: If you rename the QuickStart Jar from aem-author-p4502.jar to aem-publish-p4503.jar after the first startup, what happens?
scenes.heading: AEM still starts as Author because the tier is locked in crx-quickstart
scenes.body: After the first startup, the tier is locked in the `crx-quickstart` folder. Renaming the JAR does not change the tier — AEM reads the stored tier from `crx-quickstart`. To change the tier, you must delete `crx-quickstart` and start fresh.
